# Select

A dropdown for picking one value from a list. Built on Radix Select for keyboard navigation, type-ahead and a11y, with interruptible enter and exit. Its sibling SelectSearch adds a search field.

```tsx
import { Pizza, Hamburger, Fish, Egg, Coffee } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-56">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select a dish" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="coffee">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Coffee /> Coffee</span>
    </SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="egg">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Egg /> Eggs benedict</span>
    </SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="fish">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Fish /> Grilled fish</span>
    </SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="burger">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Hamburger /> Hamburger</span>
    </SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="pizza">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Pizza /> Pizza</span>
    </SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add select
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/select/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import { Pizza, Hamburger } from "@phosphor-icons/react"
import {
  Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent,
  SelectItem, SelectGroup, SelectLabel, SelectSeparator,
} from "@/components/ui/select"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Select>
      <SelectTrigger className="w-56">
        <SelectValue placeholder="Select a dish" />
      </SelectTrigger>
      <SelectContent>
        <SelectItem value="pizza">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Pizza /> Pizza</span>
        </SelectItem>
        <SelectItem value="burger">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Hamburger /> Hamburger</span>
        </SelectItem>
      </SelectContent>
    </Select>
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
import {
  Select,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  SelectContent,
  SelectGroup,
  SelectLabel,
  SelectItem,
  SelectSeparator,
} from "@/components/ui/select"

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger>
    <SelectValue />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectGroup>
      <SelectLabel />
      <SelectItem value="..." />
    </SelectGroup>
    <SelectSeparator />
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

## Groups and labels

Use `SelectGroup` and `SelectLabel` to group related options. Add `SelectSeparator` between groups for visual clarity.

```tsx
import { Clock } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-64">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select a timezone" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectGroup>
      <SelectLabel>Europe</SelectLabel>
      <SelectItem value="cet">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Clock /> Central European Time (CET)</span>
      </SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="gmt">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Clock /> Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)</span>
      </SelectItem>
    </SelectGroup>
    <SelectSeparator />
    <SelectGroup>
      <SelectLabel>North America</SelectLabel>
      <SelectItem value="cst">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Clock /> Central Standard Time (CST)</span>
      </SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="est">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Clock /> Eastern Standard Time (EST)</span>
      </SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="pst">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Clock /> Pacific Standard Time (PST)</span>
      </SelectItem>
    </SelectGroup>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

## Long lists

When the options outgrow the available height the menu scrolls, and its top and bottom edges fade softly into the popover, the [scroll fade](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/foundations/scroll-fade.md) utility, so there’s a clear “more above / below” cue without a scrollbar. Open this and scroll: the leading edge stays crisp, the trailing edge dissolves, and a keyboard-focused row always lands clear of the fade. The list is capped at 20rem or the room left on screen, whichever is smaller, so on a phone it scrolls inside the panel instead of running off the viewport, and the arrows at either end sit over the fade rather than pushing the rows down.

```tsx
import { MapPin } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

const cities = ["Amsterdam", "Bangkok", "Berlin" /* … */]

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-56">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select a city" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    {cities.map((city) => (
      <SelectItem key={city} value={city}>
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><MapPin /> {city}</span>
      </SelectItem>
    ))}
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

## Searching the list

Past a couple of dozen options, scrolling stops being a way to find anything. `SelectSearch` is the same select with a search field in its panel: one value, the same trigger, the same rows and the same brand check, filtered as you type. Focus stays in the field the whole time, so typing never stops: arrows move the highlight, Enter commits the active row, Escape closes. Give each row a `textValue` (what the search reads, since `value` is an id) and `keywords` for the terms people actually type - here, a city finds its timezone. Rows that don’t match render nothing, so groups, separators and the empty state collapse on their own.

```tsx
import { Clock } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

<SelectSearch>
  <SelectSearchTrigger className="w-80">
    <Clock />
    <SelectSearchValue placeholder="Select a timezone" />
  </SelectSearchTrigger>
  <SelectSearchContent>
    <SelectSearchInput placeholder="Search zones or cities…" />
    <SelectSearchList label="Timezones">
      <SelectSearchGroup>
        <SelectSearchLabel>Europe</SelectSearchLabel>
        <SelectSearchItem
          value="cet"
          textValue="Central European Time (CET)"
          keywords={["madrid", "paris", "berlin"]}
        >
          <Clock /> Central European Time (CET)
        </SelectSearchItem>
      </SelectSearchGroup>
      <SelectSearchEmpty>No timezone matches that.</SelectSearchEmpty>
    </SelectSearchList>
  </SelectSearchContent>
</SelectSearch>
```

Pass `inline` and the panel renders in the page flow under its trigger instead of floating over it, for a picker that belongs to a form or a side panel. In flow it paints no fill and no shadow, just the hairline, because [fill is elevation](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/foundations/colors.md); the trigger stays quiet too, since the search field inside the panel is what holds the focus. This one also shows `renderValue`: the value is seeded from outside and the rows only exist while the panel is open, so the trigger is told how to draw it.

```tsx
<SelectSearch inline defaultOpen defaultValue="ava" className="w-80">
  <SelectSearchTrigger>
    <SelectSearchValue
      placeholder="Assign to…"
      renderValue={(value) => <Assignee value={value} />}
    />
  </SelectSearchTrigger>
  <SelectSearchContent>
    <SelectSearchInput placeholder="Search people…" />
    <SelectSearchList label="Teammates">
      <SelectSearchItem value="ava" textValue="Ava Smith" keywords={["design lead"]}>
        <Assignee value="ava" />
      </SelectSearchItem>
      <SelectSearchEmpty>Nobody by that name.</SelectSearchEmpty>
    </SelectSearchList>
  </SelectSearchContent>
</SelectSearch>
```

## Aligned to the selected item

By default the list opens below the trigger, which keeps the trigger’s brand ring in view and matches the pickers built on Popover (CountrySelect, MultiSelect, DatePicker). Pass `position="item-aligned"` for a short, toolbar-style list: it opens with the current option laid over the trigger, so the eye never moves. Keep it to a handful of options; a long list belongs below the trigger.

```tsx
<Select defaultValue="newest">
  <SelectTrigger className="w-48">
    <SelectValue />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent position="item-aligned">
    <SelectItem value="alphabetical"><SortAscending /> Alphabetical</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="popular"><Fire /> Most popular</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="newest"><Sparkle /> Newest</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="oldest"><Clock /> Oldest</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

## Country select

A plain `Select` over ~250 countries is a long scroll, so reach for `CountrySelect`, a searchable picker that looks like a Select trigger but filters as you type and is fully keyboard-navigable. It returns the selected ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code and lives in the [Input](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/components/input.md) family, sharing the canonical country dataset and circular flags with `PhoneInput`. Inside a [Field](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/components/field.md) it wires up label, aria, and error state automatically.

```tsx
import { CountrySelect } from "@/components/ui/input"

const [country, setCountry] = useState("US")

<CountrySelect
  value={country}
  onValueChange={setCountry}
  className="w-56"
/>
```

## Option hints

Some labels are too terse to stand on their own. `High` and `Medium` say nothing about the trade-off behind them. Pass a `tooltip` to `SelectItem` to attach a hint that surfaces on hover and on keyboard focus, so the choice is informed without crowding the row. Use `tooltipPlacement` to change the side it grows toward (defaults to `right`).

```tsx
import { Gauge, Lightning, Brain } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

<Select defaultValue="low">
  <SelectTrigger className="w-56">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Reasoning effort" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="minimal" tooltip="Fastest, shallowest pass. Good for simple, well-scoped tasks.">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Gauge /> Minimal</span>
    </SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="low" tooltip="Optimizes for latency over depth.">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Lightning /> Low</span>
    </SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="medium" tooltip="Balances response speed against how hard the model thinks.">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Gauge /> Medium</span>
    </SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="high" tooltip="Deepest reasoning. Slower and more expensive, best for hard problems.">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Brain /> High</span>
    </SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

## Density

The trigger height comes from `size` on `SelectTrigger` - `sm`/`md`/`lg` map to 32/36/40px, the same scale as Button and Input, so a Select lines up with them at a shared size. `density` no longer sets the trigger height; it picks the *default* size when you do not pass one (compact → `sm`, comfortable → `md`) and tightens the dropdown menu rows. Pass `density` to `SelectContent` (or a parent `DensityProvider`) for the menu spacing.

```tsx
import { Circle } from "@phosphor-icons/react"

<Select>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-48" density="compact">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Compact" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent density="compact">
    <SelectItem value="a">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Circle /> Option A</span>
    </SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="b">
      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><Circle /> Option B</span>
    </SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

## Selecting multiple values

`Select` picks exactly one value and closes on pick. For checkboxes, switches, and sections that stay open while you toggle several values, reach for [Multi Select](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/components/multi-select.md) - a Popover-backed sibling with the same surface and motion.

## API reference

### Select

The root, Radix `Select.Root` re-exported as is; it renders no element. Every part below that renders one accepts `className`, merged last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | string | - | The selected value (controlled). |
| defaultValue | string | - | The value it starts with (uncontrolled). |
| onValueChange | (value: string) => void | - | Called when an option is picked. |
| open | boolean | - | Open state of the list (controlled). |
| defaultOpen | boolean | - | Open state on mount (uncontrolled). |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the list opens or closes. |
| name | string | - | Posts the value with a native form submit. |
| disabled | boolean | - | Disables the whole select. |
| required | boolean | - | Marks the value as required in a native form. |

### SelectTrigger

The button that opens the list, on Radix `Select.Trigger` with a turning caret appended. Inside a `Field` it takes the field's id, description and error state. Forwards every Radix trigger prop.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| size | "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" | - | Height: 32, 36 or 40px, the scale Button and Input share. Without it, a `Form` imposes its size, else density picks `sm` (compact) or `md` (comfortable). |
| density | "compact" \| "comfortable" | - | Picks the default `size` when none is passed: compact is `sm`, comfortable is `md`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `open` or `closed`. |
| data-placeholder | Present while no value is selected; the value reads lighter. |
| data-disabled | Present when the select is disabled. |

### SelectValue

Radix `Select.Value` re-exported: mirrors the chosen item (icon and label) inside the trigger.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| placeholder | React.ReactNode | - | Shown while nothing is selected. |

### SelectContent

The portalled list, on Radix `Select.Content`, with scroll arrows and a scroll fade; a popper list is capped at 20rem or the room left on screen. Forwards every Radix content prop.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| position | "popper" \| "item-aligned" | "popper" | `popper` opens below the trigger; `item-aligned` lays the current option over the trigger, for short lists. Koala's default differs from Radix's. |
| sideOffset | number | 6 | Gap (px) between trigger and list, with `popper`. |
| side | "top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left" | "bottom" | Preferred side, with `popper`. |
| align | "start" \| "center" \| "end" | "start" | Alignment against the trigger, with `popper`. |
| density | "compact" \| "comfortable" | "compact" | Row height of the list. Falls back to the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `open` or `closed`. |
| data-side | The side the list opened on, with `popper`. |
| data-align | The alignment it settled on, with `popper`. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --radix-select-trigger-width | The trigger's width; the list is at least this wide. |
| --radix-select-content-available-height | Room left on screen; caps the popper list's height. |

### SelectItem

An option, on Radix `Select.Item`, with a brand check on the right; children are a leading icon plus label. Forwards every Radix item prop.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value* | string | - | The value this option commits. |
| disabled | boolean | - | Skips the option in keyboard navigation and blocks picking it. |
| textValue | string | - | Text for type-ahead when the children are not plain text. |
| tooltip | React.ReactNode | - | A hint shown on hover and keyboard focus, for terse labels. |
| tooltipPlacement | TooltipProps["placement"] | "right" | The side the hint grows toward. |
| density | "compact" \| "comfortable" | "compact" | Row height. Falls back to the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `checked` on the selected option, else `unchecked`. |
| data-highlighted | Present on the option under the pointer or keyboard. |
| data-disabled | Present on a disabled option. |

### SelectGroup

Radix `Select.Group` re-exported: groups related options under a `SelectLabel`.

### SelectLabel

A muted group heading, on Radix `Select.Label`. Takes `density` like `SelectItem`.

### SelectSeparator

A hairline between groups, on Radix `Select.Separator`. Takes `density` like `SelectItem`.

### SelectSearch

The searchable sibling, on Radix Popover and the same recipe: one value, a search field in the panel. Renders a `<div>` only when `inline`, so `className` applies only then.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | string | - | The selected value (controlled). |
| defaultValue | string | - | The value it starts with (uncontrolled). |
| onValueChange | (value: string) => void | - | Called when a row is picked. |
| open | boolean | - | Open state of the panel (controlled). |
| defaultOpen | boolean | false | Open state on mount (uncontrolled). |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | Called when the panel opens or closes; closing clears the query. |
| inline | boolean | false | Renders the panel in the page flow under the trigger, with no fill or shadow; picking keeps it open and Escape clears the query. |
| filter | (query: string, value: string, keywords?: string[]) => number | - | Scores each row; `0` hides it. The default is a case-insensitive substring match over `textValue` and `keywords`. |
| name | string | - | Renders a hidden input so the value posts with a native form submit. |
| disabled | boolean | - | Disables the trigger. Falls back to the enclosing `Field`'s disabled state. |
| size | "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" | - | Trigger height, resolved like `SelectTrigger`'s. |
| density | "compact" \| "comfortable" | "compact" | Row height and default trigger size. Falls back to the nearest `DensityProvider`. |

### SelectSearchTrigger

The trigger `<button>`, styled like `SelectTrigger`; a leading icon may sit before the value. Inside a `Field` it takes the field's wiring. Forwards all native `<button>` props except `type`.

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `open` or `closed`. |

### SelectSearchValue

The value shown in the trigger: the label picked this session, or the placeholder. Forwards all native `<span>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| placeholder | React.ReactNode | - | Shown while nothing is selected. |
| renderValue | (value: string) => React.ReactNode | - | Draws the value yourself; needed when it is seeded from outside, since rows only exist while the panel is open. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-placeholder | Present while nothing is selected. |

### SelectSearchContent

The panel: Radix `Popover.Content` in a portal, or a plain `<div>` when `inline`. Its width matches the trigger. Forwards the Popover content props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| align | "start" \| "center" \| "end" | "start" | Alignment against the trigger. |
| sideOffset | number | 6 | Gap (px) between trigger and panel. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `open` or `closed` (always `open` inline). |
| data-side | The side the floating panel opened on. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --radix-popover-trigger-width | The trigger's width; the floating panel matches it. |

### SelectSearchInput

The search field, a `role="combobox"` Input that keeps focus while the arrows rove the rows. Forwards native `<input>` props except `value`, `onChange` and `size`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| placeholder | string | "Search…" | Placeholder of the field. |
| aria-label | string | "Search options" | Accessible name of the field. |
| className | string | - | Classes for the wrapper that insets the field. |
| inputClassName | string | - | Classes for the field itself. |

### SelectSearchList

The scrolling `role="listbox"` that holds the rows. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | string | "Options" | Accessible name of the list. |

### SelectSearchItem

A row; one that does not match the query renders nothing. Forwards all native `<div>` props except `onSelect`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value* | string | - | The value this row commits. |
| textValue | string | - | What the search matches against; defaults to `value`, so give it the visible label. |
| keywords | string[] | - | Extra terms that also match the row: a handle, a synonym, a code. |
| disabled | boolean | - | Skips the row in navigation and blocks picking it. |
| onSelect | (value: string) => void | - | Called before the row commits. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `checked` on the selected row, else `unchecked`. |
| data-active | `true` on the highlighted row, shared by pointer and keyboard. |
| data-value | The row's `value`. |
| data-disabled | Present on a disabled row. |

### SelectSearchGroup

A `role="group"` that hides, label and all, once every row in it filters out. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### SelectSearchLabel

A muted group heading. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### SelectSearchSeparator

A hairline `role="separator"` between groups. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### SelectSearchEmpty

Shown only while the list holds no row. Its `children` default to `"No results found."`. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

## FAQ

### When should I use Select versus SelectSearch, MultiSelect or CountrySelect?

Use `Select` to pick exactly one value from a short list; it closes on pick. Past a couple of dozen options, `SelectSearch` is the same select with a search field in its panel. For toggling several values with checkboxes or switches that stay open, reach for `MultiSelect`, and for the ~250-country case use the ready-made `CountrySelect` from the Input family.

### Why is SelectSearch a separate component instead of a search field inside SelectContent?

Radix Select's content owns the keyboard (its type-ahead swallows every character), pulls focus onto the selected item, and only ever exists as a portalled, focus-trapped overlay that aria-hides the rest of the page and locks scrolling. None of that can host a text field, and none of it can render in the page flow. So `SelectSearch` is built on Radix Popover, exactly like `MultiSelect`, and dressed in the SAME `selectVariants` recipe: the trigger, panel, rows, check, labels and separators can't drift from their Select twins.

### How does SelectSearch filter, and what do textValue and keywords do?

`value` is the id the row commits, so the search reads `textValue` instead (give it the visible label) plus any `keywords` - synonyms, a handle, a city, a country code. The default match is a case-insensitive substring over both; pass `filter` on the root to score matches yourself (return 0 to hide a row). A row that doesn't match renders nothing, so groups, separators and the empty state collapse with plain CSS.

### Why does my SelectSearch trigger show nothing when I seed a value?

The option rows only exist while the panel is open, so the trigger can only remember a label the user picked in this session. Seed a value from outside (a `defaultValue`, a controlled value, a saved form) and you have to tell the trigger how to draw it: pass `renderValue` to `SelectSearchValue`, the same escape hatch `MultiSelectValue` uses for chips.

### When should the search panel be inline?

Pass `inline` when the picker belongs to a form or a side panel rather than floating over the page: the panel renders in the flow under its trigger, paints no fill and no shadow (fill is elevation), and the trigger drops its open halo since the search field inside the panel is what holds the focus. Escape clears the query instead of closing, because in flow there's nothing to dismiss.

### How do I compose the parts?

Wrap everything in `Select`, put `SelectValue` (with a `placeholder`) inside a `SelectTrigger`, and list `SelectItem`s inside `SelectContent`. Organize long lists with `SelectGroup` plus `SelectLabel`, and divide groups with `SelectSeparator`.

### How do I attach a hint to a terse option?

Pass a `tooltip` string to `SelectItem` to surface a hint on hover and on keyboard focus, useful for labels like High or Medium that say nothing about the trade-off. Use `tooltipPlacement` to change the side it grows toward (defaults to `right`).

### How do I size the trigger, and where does density go?

Trigger height comes from `size` on `SelectTrigger` (sm/md/lg = 32/36/40px, the same scale as Button and Input). `density` no longer sets the height - it picks the default size when you don't pass one (compact -> sm, comfortable -> md) and tightens the dropdown rows; pass it to `SelectContent` (or a parent `DensityProvider`) for the menu spacing. An explicit `size` always wins.

### Is keyboard navigation and type-ahead handled for me?

Yes. Select is built on Radix Select, so arrow-key navigation, type-ahead search, and ARIA come for free. Mark an option `disabled` to skip it in that navigation.

### How do I add an icon to each option?

Koala's convention is a leading Phosphor icon per option: wrap the icon and label in a `<span className="flex items-center gap-2">` inside the `SelectItem`. Render icons in outline weight to match the rest of the system.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli@latest add select` writes `components/ui/select/`. Import from `@/components/ui/select`:

- Components and helpers: `Select`, `SelectGroup`, `SelectValue`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectContent`, `SelectItem`, `SelectLabel`, `SelectSeparator`, `selectVariants`, `SelectSearch`, `SelectSearchTrigger`, `SelectSearchValue`, `SelectSearchContent`, `SelectSearchInput`, `SelectSearchList`, `SelectSearchItem`, `SelectSearchGroup`, `SelectSearchLabel`, `SelectSearchSeparator`, `SelectSearchEmpty`
- Types: `SelectTriggerProps`, `SelectContentProps`, `SelectItemProps`, `SelectSearchProps`, `SelectSearchTriggerProps`, `SelectSearchValueProps`, `SelectSearchContentProps`, `SelectSearchInputProps`, `SelectSearchListProps`, `SelectSearchItemProps`, `SelectSearchFilter`
- Koala components it installs with it: `input`, `tooltip`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `create-context`, `density`, `field-context`, `tv`, `utils`
- npm packages: `@phosphor-icons/react`, `radix-ui`
